assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production Unity game UI transparent sprite.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the existing CAST POWER timing panel. Input image 2 is the STYLE REFERENCE: the supplied Play and equipment panel.
Restyle ONLY image 1 to look like it belongs to exactly the same UI kit as image 2. Keep the target's 3:1 horizontal shape and every internal element's location and proportional dimensions. Replace all wood, ropes, brass, gold frame, anchors and rivets with the reference's clean slim luminous CYAN rounded rectangular outline and dark blue inner edge, cobalt-to-aqua-to-indigo blue gradient face, a few small glossy bubbles and green seaweed at the lower outside corners. No pirate theme. Keep the fish-reel icon at left but draw it as a simpler clean turquoise/silver cartoon reel in a cyan circle, without rope, anchors or brass.
Precise normalized layout, canvas 960 by320: heading CAST POWER occupies x270..690,y60..113; a blank dark navy percent socket occupies x750..865,y65..105; empty horizontal timing lane spans x222..904,y136..220, with working lane center x252..864,y183; bottom caption STOP IN THE GOLD occupies x270..700,y241..286. Heading and caption bold rounded white uppercase with dark navy outline like the reference. Only exact text "CAST POWER" and "STOP IN THE GOLD". Gold/yellow allowed in the word GOLD and tiny accents only. Completely opaque panel interior; transparent exterior, no checkerboard, no cropped border. Crisp 2D vector-like raster, native wide high resolution, straight-on, no perspective. Full complete panel fills canvas with small transparent margins.
